title: FocalPO: Enhancing Preference Optimizing by Focusing on Correct Preference Rankings
authors_zh: Tong Liu, Xiao Yu, Wenxuan Zhou, Jindong Gu, Volker Tresp（慕尼黑大学、哥伦比亚大学、南加州大学、牛津大学、慕尼黑机器学习中心）
paper_type_zh: 偏好回答对加权与优化目标研究
best_for_zh: 适合决定当前排序错误的困难偏好回答对是否应主导离线对齐更新的读者。
one_line: FocalPO reweights DPO so preference pairs with correct current implicit rankings contribute more than misranked pairs.
FocalPO 重加权 DPO，使当前隐式排序正确的偏好回答对比排序错误的回答对贡献更大。
why: It challenges DPO's default emphasis on pairs the model currently gets wrong and makes ranking state an explicit training-use signal.
inclusion_reason: It directly changes the loss weight assigned to each preference record according to whether the current model already ranks that record correctly.

title: Problem
问题
html:
DPO gives large gradient emphasis to pairs whose current implicit reward ranks the rejected answer above the chosen answer. Yet prior evidence cited by the paper shows that training rarely repairs those misrankings. Letting such pairs dominate can therefore spend optimization effort on signals the model does not currently resolve reliably.

FocalPO asks whether pair importance should depend on the model's current ability to rank the pair. It keeps the dataset fixed but changes its consumer: correctly ranked pairs become relatively more influential and misranked pairs less influential. The paper studies a training-use decision, not a new collection protocol.

DPO 会对当前隐式奖励把劣选答案排在优选答案之前的回答对赋予较大的梯度强调。但论文引用的先前证据表明，训练很少修复这些错误排序。让此类回答对主导训练，因而可能把优化精力花在模型当前不能可靠处理的信号上。

FocalPO 询问回答对的重要性是否应取决于模型当前排序该回答对的能力。它保持数据集不变，却改变其消费者：正确排序的回答对相对更有影响，错误排序的回答对相对更少影响。论文研究的是训练使用决策，而不是新的收集流程。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
FocalPO multiplies the DPO loss by a focal probability factor. When the preferred answer already has a high implicit preference probability, the resulting gradient gives that correctly ranked pair greater relative weight; when the pair is misranked, its contribution is suppressed. This reverses the usual focal-loss intuition because the goal is to prioritize reliable preference signal rather than difficult classification cases.

The method requires no extra label, reward model, or sample generation. A fixed focusing parameter controls the strength of the reweighting, and the reported experiments set it to 0.05 for both model families. Thus the same binary record changes influence as the evolving model changes its implicit ranking.

FocalPO 用焦点概率因子乘以 DPO 损失。当优选答案已经具有较高的隐式偏好概率时，产生的梯度会给该正确排序的回答对更大的相对权重；当回答对排序错误时，其贡献会被压制。这颠倒了通常的焦点损失直觉，因为目标是优先使用可靠偏好信号，而不是困难分类案例。

该方法不需要额外标签、奖励模型或样本生成。固定焦点参数控制重加权强度，报告的实验对两种模型家族都设为 0.05。因此，同一个二元记录会随着演化中的模型改变其隐式排序而改变影响力。

title: Method
方法
html:
For each instruction and chosen-rejected pair, the model computes DPO's preference probability from policy-to-reference log-probability ratios. FocalPO replaces the usual negative log probability with a scaled version using a probability-to-the-gamma factor. Gradient analysis shows that this produces larger weights for pairs with accurate implicit reward order and smaller weights for pairs with incorrect order.

The paper trains Mistral-Base-7B on UltraFeedback and Llama-3-Instruct-8B on Llama3-ultrafeedback-armorm, for one epoch with batch size 128. It fixes gamma at 0.05 and grid-searches learning rates. DPO, SimPO, KTO, and ORPO are compared, while a separate experiment applies the opposite focal direction to emphasize incorrectly ranked pairs.

对于每条指令和优选—劣选回答对，模型从策略与参考模型的对数概率比计算 DPO 的偏好概率。FocalPO 用带概率 gamma 次方因子的缩放版本替换通常的负对数概率。梯度分析表明，这会给隐式奖励排序准确的回答对更大权重，给排序错误的回答对更小权重。

论文让 Mistral-Base-7B 在 UltraFeedback 上训练，让 Llama-3-Instruct-8B 在 Llama3-ultrafeedback-armorm 上训练，使用批大小 128 训练一个轮次。它将 gamma 固定为 0.05，并网格搜索学习率。比较对象是 DPO、SimPO、KTO 和 ORPO；另一个实验采用相反焦点方向来强调排序错误的回答对。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
For Llama-3-Instruct-8B, FocalPO reports 49.8% AlpacaEval win rate, 54.7% length-controlled win rate, and 34.6% Arena-Hard win rate, compared with DPO at 47.5%, 48.2%, and 33.1%. For Mistral-Base-7B, it reports 20.4%, 23.9%, and 17.1%, compared with DPO at 18.6%, 20.6%, and 16.4%.

The controlled ranking experiment is central evidence. Emphasizing incorrectly ranked pairs with the conventional focal direction performs worse than DPO, whereas emphasizing correctly ranked pairs with the proposed direction outperforms DPO. This supports the paper's claim that current ranking correctness is a useful signal for deciding how strongly a pair should affect training.

对于 Llama-3-Instruct-8B，FocalPO 报告 AlpacaEval 胜率 49.8%、长度控制胜率 54.7%、Arena-Hard 胜率 34.6%，而 DPO 分别为 47.5%、48.2% 和 33.1%。对于 Mistral-Base-7B，它报告 20.4%、23.9% 和 17.1%，而 DPO 为 18.6%、20.6% 和 16.4%。

受控排序实验是核心证据。用常规焦点方向强调排序错误回答对的表现差于 DPO，而用所提方向强调正确排序回答对的表现优于 DPO。这支持论文的主张：当前排序正确性是决定一个回答对应以多大强度影响训练的有用信号。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Prior DPO variants use margins or alternate objectives, but FocalPO makes the model's current ranking state an explicit record-level weight. Its surprising choice is to prioritize pairs already ranked correctly, rather than treating misranked pairs as automatically more informative. This turns a diagnosis of implicit-reward reliability into a direct optimization decision.

The contribution also isolates the two directions experimentally. By showing that the conventional emphasis on incorrect pairs underperforms while the proposed emphasis succeeds, the paper makes a narrower claim than generic hard-example mining. It says that in this preference-learning setting, difficult pairs can be less useful before the model has a reliable ranking signal.

先前的 DPO 变体使用间隔或替代目标，但 FocalPO 把模型当前的排序状态变成显式的记录级权重。它令人意外的选择是优先处理已经正确排序的回答对，而不是把排序错误的回答对自动视为更有信息。这把对隐式奖励可靠性的诊断变成直接的优化决策。

该贡献还通过实验隔离了两个方向。它表明常规地强调错误回答对会表现更差，而所提的强调方式会成功，因此提出的主张比一般的困难示例挖掘更狭窄。它说明在这种偏好学习设置中，在模型拥有可靠排序信号之前，困难回答对可能更没有用。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The authors test two model families and a fixed gamma value, leaving broader hyperparameter tuning and other model-dataset combinations open. The method assumes current ranking correctness is a useful proxy for training reliability, so it cannot distinguish a genuinely informative hard pair from a mislabeled or temporarily difficult one. It also does not address data coverage, safety labels, or judge bias; the primary alignment scores rely on LLM-based benchmarks.
作者测试了两个模型家族和固定 gamma 值，因此更广的超参数调优及其他模型—数据集组合仍待探索。该方法假定当前排序正确性是训练可靠性的有用代理，因而无法区分真正有信息量的困难回答对、标签错误的回答对和暂时困难的回答对。它也不处理数据覆盖、安全标签或评判偏见；主要对齐分数依赖基于大模型的基准。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: FocalPO is useful when an offline DPO run is unstable or appears dominated by samples the model cannot yet rank. It is a low-overhead alternative to discarding data, because every pair stays available but its contribution adapts to current model state. It is less suitable when the central failure is bad preference annotation, since reweighting cannot establish which label is correct.
当离线 DPO 运行不稳定，或似乎被模型尚不能排序的样本主导时，FocalPO 很有用。它是丢弃数据的低开销替代方案，因为每个回答对仍然可用，但其贡献会适应当前模型状态。当核心失败是糟糕的偏好标注时，它不太适合，因为重新加权无法确定哪个标签正确。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the gradient discussion with Figure 4 before interpreting the benchmark table: FocalPO is not a data-quality filter but an evolving loss weight. Then compare the two focal directions in Figure 1, which is the evidence for prioritizing correct rankings. Finally read DynamicFocalPO as the temporal extension: it retains the same premise but relaxes this paper's fixed-gamma decision over the course of training.
在解读基准表之前，先结合图 4 阅读梯度讨论：FocalPO 不是数据质量过滤器，而是不断演化的损失权重。然后比较图 1 中的两个焦点方向，它是优先正确排序的证据。最后阅读 DynamicFocalPO 作为时间扩展：它保留相同前提，却在训练过程中放宽本文固定 gamma 的决策。
